summary: - _(c) Pass such other relief as the Hon'ble Commission deems fit and appropriate under the circumstances of the case_ (f) In regard to the activity of utilization of transmission towers for mounting the telecom antennas, BTS and associated auxiliary power supply equipment for mobile communication, the Petitioner, in Petition No. 287/MP/2022, had informed this Commission that though it has been exploring the above activity, however, so far the same could not be commenced and had sought liberty from this Commission for filing of a fresh Petition to undertake the said business at appropriate time through Petitioner/POWERTEL. On 17.05.2023, this Commission passed an order in Petition No. 287/MP/2022 whereby this Commission has taken on record, details filed by the Petitioner, as intimation under Regulation 4(1) of the Sharing of Revenue Regulations 2020 of continuation of Telecommunications and Digital Technology Businesses and accorded the approval for undertaking of existing Telecommunications and Digital Technology business of Petitioner, through the WOS company “POWERTEL”. - **vii. Any other details required by the Commission:** Petitioner undertakes to place the information and documents as and when sought by this Commission. - (j) Petitioner undertakes to comply with all the conditions and stipulations mentioned in the order dated 28.05.2019 in Petition No. 180/MP/2017 and the order dated 17.05.2023 in Petition No. 287/MP/2022 (inasmuch as the conditions apply), including the following: _3. After hearing the Petitioner, the Commission issued the following directions:_ - _c. The Petitioner to serve a copy of the petition on the Respondents by 14.3.2024._ _4. The Commission further directed the Petitioner to submit the following information on an affidavit by 14.3.2024, with an advance copy to the Respondents:_ _5. The Commission also directed the Petitioner to serve a copy of the petition on the Respondents by 7.3.2024, and the Respondents may file their replies by 22.3.2024, with an advance copy to the Petitioner, and the Petitioner to file its rejoinder if any, by 5.4.2024. The Commission further directed the Petitioner to adhere to the above timelines and observed that no extension of time would be entertained_ _4. The Commission further directed the Petitioner to submit the following information, on an affidavit, with a copy to the Respondents, within two weeks:_ - a) During the proceedings of the petition 180/MP/2017, the Commission had constituted a committee under the chairmanship of Chief (Finance) with Chief (Engineering) and Chief (Law) as members to look into the technical and financial aspects of the project by considering how the Petitioner would like to share its revenue with the beneficiaries. - _ .. The learned counsel further submitted that the Petitioner has also filed the additional information sought vide the last Record of Proceedings. Further, the Petitioner has inter alia undertaken to comply with all the conditions & stipulations mentioned by the Commission in the order dated 28.5.2019 in Petition No. 180/MP/2017 and order dated 17.5.2023 in Petition No. 287/MP/2022, including sharing of revenue in the ratio of 50:50 of the net revenue, i.e. after deduction of all direct and indirect costs, with the LTTCs. The learned counsel, while pointing out that none of the Respondents has filed any reply despite multiple opportunities, requested that the matter be reserved for order._ _2.After hearing the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the Commission deemed it appropriate to allow all the Respondents to file their replies/ written submissions, if any, within a week, with a copy to the Petitioner, who may file its rejoinder/ written submissions, if any, within a week thereafter._ 6. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner. The following issues arise for our consideration: ## _**Issue No. 1: Whether the proposal of the Petitioner is contrary to the provisions of the Act?**_ _60. The Commission in foregoing paras has analyzed the legal issues raised by various Respondents and has concluded that the proposal of the petitioner is not contrary to the provisions of the Act. Accordingly, we allow the proposed business of the Petitioner._ 8. Subsequently, Petitioner filed a Petition No. 287/MP/2022, intimating about the continuation of Telecommunications and Digital Technology Businesses under the Sharing of Revenue Regulations 2020 and seeking prior approval of the Commission to undertake the existing Telecommunications and Digital Technology business of Petitioner, through its WOS company. Relevant extract of the order dated 17.05.2023 is as under: - (i) The Petitioner shall indemnify all the long-term transmission customers for any additional cost, losses, or damages caused due to the proposed business being carried by the Petitioner or its Wholly Owned Subsidiary (WOS) company. 13. Petitioner shall file a separate petition after completion of two years of implementation of the project with technical details of the business as implemented and its effect on the transmission system, if any. _62. The Petitioner has proposed to pay the beneficiaries as recommended in the report submitted by KPMG. As per this, the Petitioner will get Return on Equity (RoE) @15.5% on its capital investment. The Petitioner has proposed to pay to the beneficiaries @ Rs.12,000/ location/ year (Approx-13.5% of profit before tax). Respondents have objected to sharing of only about 13.5% of profit before tax with the beneficiaries._ _66.We have considered the submissions of the parties. It is observed that the business proposed by the Petitioner is at a nascent stage and the Petitioner is yet to ascertain the financial viability of the proposed business as the same would largely depend upon various factors such as number of towers utilized, location of tower and business of telecom players in the area (population/ prosperity level)._
title: Petition under Regulation 4(1) of Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Sharing of Revenue Derived from Utilization of Transmission Assets for Other Business) Regulation, 2020 for (a) intimation about continuation of business for offering its transmission towers for placement of telecom & radio antenna, power & telecom equipment and drawing power from earth wire (b) seeking approval to undertake the business either by Petitioner or through its wholly owned subsidiary company- POWERGRID TELESERVICES LIMITED Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd
